tasks.title: GET /healthz says the service is up
acceptance: `GET /healthz` answers 200 with `{ok: true}`; a test starts the server on a free port and asserts it.

tasks.title: POST /notes creates a note
acceptance: `POST /notes` with `{text}` answers 201 with `{id, text, created}`; ids are small integers that never repeat; a test creates two notes and asserts ids 1 and 2.

tasks.title: GET /notes lists the notes
acceptance: `GET /notes` answers 200 with every note, oldest first; a test creates two and lists them.

tasks.title: GET /notes/:id reads one note
acceptance: `GET /notes/:id` answers 200 with the note, or 404 `{error: "not_found"}`; a test asserts both.

tasks.title: DELETE /notes/:id removes a note
acceptance: `DELETE /notes/:id` answers 204 and the note is gone from the list, or 404 when absent; a test asserts both.

tasks.title: GET /notes?q= searches the notes
acceptance: `GET /notes?q=<word>` answers the notes whose text contains the word, case-insensitive; a test asserts a hit and a miss.
